cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you go, read the final dinner bill with me.

mechanism: A assumes the authority to keep B present until a concrete number or consequence is jointly witnessed, refusing substitutes that leave the result deniable.
confusable: D170 seeks a closing ritual; D194 requires an actual contest or bargain outcome, so weighing or reading a bill must supply the end condition.
comparison: Pumpkin rivalry demands witnessed weight; dinner cost demands shared inspection of an itemized consequence before payment separates them.
seedUse: Read both cards and four canonical seeds. Preserve finite measured results; do not replace them with arbitrary extra ceremonies or indefinite delay.
